summary: Milestone 2 backend+frontend regression testing complete. Full pytest suite: 56/56 passed (test_feature_engineering=27, test_firms_pipeline=9, test_model_inference=9, test_ml_classify_api=6, test_thermointel_api=2 – matches expected total, includes 36 new deterministic Milestone-2 tests). Verified all requested API endpoints via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: /api/regions returns updated all-india bbox [68.0,6.0,98.0,38.0] and still lists Gujarat/Maharashtra/Odisha; /api/ingestion/status shows firms.source='VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT' + status='configuration_required'; POST /api/ingestion/firms without key returns 503 with clean 'not configured' message and no secret leakage; /api/model/status has metrics_available=false and both trained models loaded=true; /api/dashboard/summary + /api/anomalies + /api/facilities + /api/hotspots + /api/alerts all 200 with data_mode='DEMO DATA' from the new data_mode_label() helper; /api/ml/schema returns exact 18/15 feature counts; /api/analyst answers with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY configured. Frontend smoke check: dashboard loads on public URL, 'All India' is the default region scope, Leaflet map renders with demo markers, region filters Gujarat/Maharashtra/Odisha present, 'DEMO DATA' badge visible. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: FIRMS live pipeline (firms_pipeline.run_firms_ingestion) is only exercised via mocked unit tests in this sandbox because FIRMS_API_KEY is unset and outbound network to overpass-api.de is blocked; once a real key + network are available in a staging env, run at least one live end-to-end ingestion to confirm dedup/upsert against MongoDB and observation_id unique index behavior under real payload variance.
server.py has grown fairly large — consider extracting the ingestion routes and data_mode_label helper into a routers/ingestion.py module for maintainability if it crosses ~700 lines.
Analyst endpoint returns 422 (Pydantic validation) rather than the spec-suggested 503 when input is invalid; that's actually correct HTTP semantics — no action needed, just noting for the main agent.
